evals.prompt: Assess whether dotnet/aspnetcore#NNNN is ready to begin fix investigation. It is a supported released-SDK runtime report with an attached minimal repro. Keep this read-only and do not suggest a fix.
evals.expected_output: A validated local readiness receipt backed by executable evidence, with one disposition and ready issues routed neutrally to fix_investigation.
expectations: The readiness assessment consumes existing upstream triage rather than assigning new labels or type.
The receipt records issue revision, repository SHA, environment, checks, commands, evidence hashes, confidence, blockers, reason code, disposition, and route.
Ready for fix investigation requires executable reproduction evidence when feasible.
Reporter-controlled repro code runs only in a credential-free sandbox with external networking denied, explicit loopback, and authorized disposable/cache/temp roots.
No fix is proposed and no GitHub resource is mutated.

evals.prompt: Tell me whether a Blazor issue that only reproduces under InteractiveAuto is ready to begin fix investigation. The reporter omitted a sample and SDK version. Do not change the issue or build a fix.
evals.expected_output: A bounded receipt that reports missing reporter evidence, records missing upstream signals, and delegates any eventual browser mechanics to validate-blazor-feature.
expectations: Missing issue evidence is reported rather than guessed.
Components browser mechanics are delegated to validate-blazor-feature.
The issue is not marked ready based on source inspection alone.
The output names one primary disposition and keeps other observations as supporting findings.

evals.prompt: Assess an ASP.NET Core issue whose current labels and maintainer comment identify it as a duplicate of a released fix. Do not post anything.
evals.expected_output: A high-confidence duplicate-or-already-fixed readiness receipt citing the canonical existing issue or release and stopping before reproduction.
expectations: Verified duplicate or already-fixed evidence wins by deterministic precedence.
The assessment stops without unnecessary build or reproduction work.
The receipt remains bound to dotnet/aspnetcore and the observed issue revision.
The safety attestation records no GitHub mutations, Microsoft 365 writes, or fixes.
